meta.title: Feishu confirmations
meta.description: Mirror DSH human confirmations (question options and permission approvals) into Feishu cards/messages so you can answer away from the computer. Desktop and Feishu race for the first submission; the other side is told the request is complete or expired. A settings page holds the app ID/secret, delivery target, and receive mode, so anyone can install the plugin and configure their own app.
